$description: TOK-0001: hoyadb documentation design tokens (W3C Design Tokens Format Module). Restates the values implemented in docs/public/assets/style.css; CSS-only values (ch, em, clamp) are listed in TOK-0001-documentation-design-tokens.md.

default.$description: Body text, headings, brand name and card text (CSS --ink). 14.91:1 on surface.page.

muted.$description: Lead paragraphs, captions, footer, sidebar group headings and version badge (CSS --muted). 6.08:1 on surface.page, 5.62:1 on surface.subtle.

default.$description: The single brand accent: links, eyebrow, card titles, callout rule and brand mark background (CSS --green). 7.23:1 on surface.page.

hover.$description: Link hover state of accent.default. 11.33:1 on surface.page.

on-accent.$description: Text placed on accent.default, such as the brand mark letter. 7.23:1.

subtle.$description: Sidebar, table header, inline code and callout background (CSS --soft).
Decorative dividers: header, sidebar, table rows, cards, pager and version badge (CSS --line). Never the only boundary of an interactive control.

control.$description: Search input border. Measured 2.62:1 on surface.page, below the 3:1 of WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11; recorded as a known gap in TOK-0001.

ring.$description: Visible focus outline for links, inputs and main (SC 2.4.7). Deliberately not green so focus differs from link color. 6.03:1 on surface.page, 5.57:1 on surface.subtle.

callable.$description: Function and method names on code.background. 8.80:1.

sans.$description: All prose and interface text. System fonts only: no external font files or CDN (UX-0003).

mark.$description: Italic letter inside the brand mark only (CMP-0001).

base.$description: Root font size; rem values in TOK-0001 are relative to it.

code.$description: Code blocks at widths above layout.breakpoint-narrow.

code-narrow.$description: Code blocks at or below layout.breakpoint-narrow.

regular.$description: Body text and the brand 'docs' suffix.

label.$description: Form labels such as the search label.

code.$description: Code block line height at every width (UX-0003).

offset.$description: Focus outline offset; keeps the ring outside the focused element.

card-padding.$description: Card padding, callout horizontal padding and code block padding above layout.breakpoint-narrow.

code-padding-narrow.$description: Code block padding at or below layout.breakpoint-narrow.

gutter-narrow.$description: Horizontal page gutter at or below layout.breakpoint-narrow.

max-width.$description: Maximum width of the sidebar plus article grid.

article-max-width.$description: Maximum width of the main article column.

breakpoint-narrow.$description: At or below this viewport width, navigation moves above the article and cards stack (UX-0003).
